newsitem.title: UK: BICC rights issue to raise 170 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: BICC rights issue to raise 170 mln stg.

text.p: Construction-to-cable group BICC Plc said it would make a 2-for-11 rights issue at 270 pence per share to raise 170 million stg.
It said it had identified over 200 million stg of additional investment opportunities which needed to be taken in the short term "in line with anticipated growth in relevant markets."
The group said it planned investment of around 140 million stg in optical fibres, Brand-Rex data communications cables and high voltage calbling.
An extra 40 million is earmarked for the Asia-Pacific region and 35 million for equity investment in infrastructure projects which require private finance both in the UK and abroad.
BICC's group debt remains "contained" but restructuring and write-off costs have significantly reduced shareholders' funds, thereby pushing up the gearing level.
"The new equity will reduce borrowings immediately and strenthen the balance sheet," it said.
The decisions on investment follow a strategic review carried out by chief executive Alan Jones.

BICC chairman Viscount Weir said in a statement: "The board now believes the time is right to focus on the future development of the business and significantly accelerate the pace of its investment to facilitate faster growth."
The rights issue has been underwritten by Schroders and brokers are Cazenove & Co and Hoare Govett Corporate Finance.
In the expected timetable for the rights issue, dealings are seen beginning on September 20.
